items.t: Driver's window master switch can overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace driver's power window master switch
items.note: Free under Honda's window switch recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: A/C compressor or compressor clutch failure
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, flush system and recharge
items.note: A clutch or coil-only repair costs less. After an internal failure, the drier and expansion valve are replaced too.

items.t: Rear differential groans on tight turns
items.job: Drain and refill rear differential with Honda fluid
items.note: Some cars need the fluid changed twice to stop the groan.

items.t: Rear frame rust can let a trailing arm break loose (recall 23V-228)
items.job: Inspect and reinforce rear frame (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 23V-228. Check your VIN. Badly rusted frames may need major repair.

items.t: Door lock actuators fail
items.job: Replace door lock actuator
items.note: Price is per door.

items.t: Loud rattle for a few seconds on cold start (VTC actuator)
items.job: Replace VTC actuator (cam gear)
items.note: Shops often replace the timing chain and tensioner at the same time, which adds parts cost.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.job: Replace piston rings (engine teardown)
items.note: Honda's old piston ring warranty extension has mostly ended; ask a dealer. A used engine may cost less.

items.t: Front door will not open from the inside
items.job: Reattach or replace inside door handle cable

items.t: Vibration at idle
items.job: Update engine software per Honda bulletin
items.note: If engine mounts are also worn, replacing them costs more.

items.t: CVT judder or surge on light acceleration
items.job: Update CVT software and change CVT fluid
items.note: If the CVT is damaged and must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Fuel in the engine oil (oil dilution)
items.job: Update engine software and change oil
items.note: Honda covered the software update and extended warranty in many states. Ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Automatic emergency braking activates with nothing ahead
items.job: Update radar and camera software, recalibrate sensors
items.note: Usually done under warranty if the car is still covered. A replaced radar or camera costs much more.

items.t: A/C stops cooling from a compressor seal leak
items.job: Replace A/C compressor and recharge
items.note: Ask a Honda dealer whether bulletin A23-015 or goodwill covers your car.

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall 23V-858)
items.job: Replace fuel pump (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 23V-858. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear subframe can separate (recall 19V-865)
items.job: Replace rear subframe (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 19V-865. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front passenger airbag may deploy wrongly (seat weight sensor recall)
items.job: Replace passenger seat weight sensor (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda's seat sensor recalls. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Steering can feel stiff or sticky (recall 24V-744)
items.job: Inspect steering gearbox and install new worm gear spring
items.note: Free under recall 24V-744. Check your VIN. If the steering gearbox must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump can crack and leak (recall 24V-763)
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 24V-763. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Burnt exhaust valves from tight valve clearance
items.job: Valve job or cylinder head replacement
items.note: A valve clearance adjustment alone is about 1.5 to 2.5 hours and prevents this.

items.t: Ignition switch can cut out and stall the engine (recall 02V-120)
items.job: Replace ignition switch electrical portion
items.note: Free under recall 02V-120. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Battery goes flat after sitting
items.job: Test charging system, replace battery and A/C relay
items.note: Parasitic drain testing can add diagnostic time.
